procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; crates/cw-sim/tests/takeovers.rs (15 fixtures with hand-worked escrow, fee, proration, squeeze-out and refund arithmetic) plus corporate_lifecycle::a_legal_merger_moves_assets_debt_facilities_and_contracts and a_funded_hostile_tender_transfers_control_and_pays_minorities.
limitations: Asset purchases assume no liabilities and cannot target a player-controlled company (no player consent step). Hostile defences beyond holder reservation factors and the defence-meeting card are not modelled. The 90 percent squeeze-out is an explicit game threshold, not statutory law.
